verses.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?

xrefs.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

verses.text: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,

xrefs.text: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

verses.text: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,

xrefs.text: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.

Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.

verses.text: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,

xrefs.text: As soon as Jephthah saw her, he tore his clothes and said, “No! Not my daughter! You have brought me to my knees! You have brought great misery upon me, for I have given my word to the LORD and cannot take it back.”
Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.

verses.text: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

xrefs.text: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
In you they take bribes to shed blood. You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
Do not charge your brother interest on money, food, or any other type of loan.
Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord, will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
